## Texts and drawings (5)

- **E0199** (text, sure): 日下舊聞考 丛芳榭. 1780s (乾隆 敕撰) · j83:12b-13a · S05. https://github.com/kanripo/KR2k0036/blob/master/KR2k0036_083.txt
  > 平疇交逺風之東為叢芳榭後為琴清齋（長春園册）臣等謹案琴清齋内額曰霞蹤天想
  East of 平疇交逺風: 叢芳榭 and 琴清齋 behind it.
- **E0200** (poem, sure): 琴清斋. 乾隆二十四年 (1759) · v3 p.373, under 狮子林; source ref 6-695 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382569071850.pdf#page=376
  > 髙斋枕碧川，琴清名有年。徒观澄止水，未听鸣响泉。却讶渊明室，别体蓄无弦。
  Poem 琴清斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1759, filed by the editors under 狮子林.
- **E0201** (poem, sure): 琴清斋. 乾隆二十九年 (1764) · v3 p.373, under 狮子林; source ref 8-763 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382569071850.pdf#page=376
  > 书斋临水号琴清，正是春温和且平。何必七弦虞拨剌，由来太古自然声。
  Poem 琴清斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1764, filed by the editors under 狮子林.
- **E0202** (poem, likely): 琴清斋口号. 乾隆五十八年 (1793) · v3 p.407, under 狮子林; source ref 18-619 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382569071850.pdf#page=410
  > 远瀑漫寻七弦比，近湖恒对五音清。那更陶壁相唐突，个里无声却有声。
  Poem 琴清斋口号 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1793, filed by the editors under 狮子林.
- **E0223** (description, sure): 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 狮子林. 2020 edition · v3 p.372 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382569071850.pdf#page=375
  Two gardens: 丛芳榭 of 1747 (five-bay hall on the lake, 琴清斋 behind, 漾月 and 集虚 pavilions), and from 1772 the Suzhou copy to its north-east. It lists the sixteen scenes, and says Qianlong's copy of Ni Zan's painting was kept in 清閟阁. Partly rebuilt 1828.

**On the plan:** Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 琴清斋, 2x1 cells. https://artmuseum.princeton.edu/collections/objects/138657
